visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at night with a wide shot of a 'Seria' store exterior. The building is white and brightly lit from within, contrasting with the dark night sky. There is snow visible on the ground near the parking lot. (2) Inside a car, a close-up shows a person's hands holding a Seria brand storage pouch still in its plastic retail packaging. The hands rotate the product to show the labels and the 6-ring binder holes. (3) Using a pair of silver scissors, the person carefully trims off the plastic edge containing the binder holes, transforming the pouch into a standalone pocket. The car's dashboard and steering wheel are visible in the soft, warm interior lighting. (4) The pouch is shown filled with various Japanese Yen coins. The transparent plastic allows the metallic textures of the silver and copper coins to be clearly seen. (5) A retail pack of LE SSERAFIM stickers is presented. Hands peel off a specific sticker featuring 'Hong Eunchae' and apply it firmly to the front of the transparent coin pouch. (6) A young male character with short dark hair, wearing a black puffer jacket, appears on screen. He holds the finished DIY wallet and talks directly into the camera from the driver's seat. His facial expression is animated and enthusiastic. (7) Close-up shots demonstrate the pouch holding paper currency (1000 Yen bills) and being tucked into a larger 6-ring binder filled with other cards and decorative items. The video ends with a freeze-frame of two modified pouches.

(2) A crisp sound of metallic scissors cutting through plastic is heard, followed by the soft rustling of a plastic pouch being handled. (3) A sharp 'click' or 'snap' sound occurs as the plastic button on the pouch is opened and closed. The male narrator continues to speak at a rapid pace. (4) The sound of a sticker being peeled away from its paper backing is clearly audible, followed by the sound of hands smoothing it onto plastic. (5) A female voice briefly exclaims in the background with a surprised and happy tone. The music swells slightly in volume during this transition. (6) The male narrator's voice becomes more authoritative and instructional, explaining costs and locations. The BGM maintains its steady tempo until the final second where a high-pitched 'ding' sound effects signals the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a creative and budget-friendly 'life hack' for travelers in Japan, showing how to create a DIY wallet/coin purse using affordable items from a Seria store.
